# Bansify — Leadership

> Bansify builds consumer cloud software — Account, Mail and AI. Five people, five roles, one
> company at the earliest possible stage.

## Pages

- https://leadership.bansify.com/ — overview, five cards
- https://leadership.bansify.com/founder/ — Pawan Kumar Meena, Founder & CTO
- https://leadership.bansify.com/cofounder/ — Vishnu Meena, Co-founder & COO
- https://leadership.bansify.com/ceo/ — Krishna Namdev, CEO & Founding Engineer
- https://leadership.bansify.com/cmo/ — Gaurav, CMO
- https://leadership.bansify.com/engineering/ — Yuvkesh Meena, Founding Engineer

## Notes

- Bansify is not yet a registered company. The titles are internal designations, not
  statutory posts or directorships.
- Each person's page states what they own, their ninety-day aim, and what is not theirs.
- Organization: https://www.bansify.com · Source: https://github.com/Bansify
